hardware.title: Building toward integrated software-and-hardware capability
hardware.subtitle: Sadenia Systems is expanding its technology value chain with a planned laptop and hardware assembly operation.
hardware.intro: Hardware assembly represents the next phase of Sadenia Systems' growth — extending from software and systems development into integrated technology manufacturing. This initiative is part of our commitment to delivering complete technology solutions to the Congolese market.
hardware.vision: To establish a fully operational laptop-assembly lab within six months, enabling Sadenia to deliver affordable, quality hardware alongside its software and systems capabilities.
hardware.approach: Rather than importing finished products, Sadenia is building local assembly capacity — creating jobs, building technical expertise, and providing hardware tailored to the needs of Congolese organizations and consumers.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Planning & Sourcing
phases.desc: Component sourcing, supplier partnerships and facility preparation for the assembly lab.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Lab Setup
phases.desc: Assembly lab installation, tooling, quality control processes and staff training.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Pilot Production
phases.desc: Initial laptop assembly runs, quality validation and performance testing.

phases.title: Phase 4 — Full Operations
phases.desc: Commercial production, product range expansion and market distribution.

hardware.note: Detailed product specifications, manufacturing capacity and commercial offerings will be available once the assembly lab is operational and management has approved public disclosure.
